basic_details.job_title: IICA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Project Assistant, Chief Program Executive and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Senior Research Associate, Chief Program Executive, Project Assistant
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Purely contractual, initially for one year

qualification.details: The closing date is also the crucial date for the eligibility conditions. Provisional claims regarding eligibility will not be accepted. | Mandatory qualification: Full-time post-graduate degree in Social Sciences, Statistics or a qualification related to CSR and Sustainability, or related to needs assessments, SROI, baseline surveys, impact evaluation etc. | Mandatory experience and abilities: | Minimum 3-5 years of general experience in CSR and Sustainability Proven skills in research and report writing connected to need analysis and impact assessment Excellent command of research design, data collection and analysis, MS-Office suite and other data analysis tools Professional experience in writing and publishing need and impact assessments Proven experience in developing research proposals, implementing field studies and report writing connected to need and impact assessment | Skill set: | Conducting and reviewing literature reviews for baseline surveys, needs assessments and impact assessments Developing assessment and evaluation tools for field data collection Compiling and analysing data for assessment reports, and preparing draft reports for baseline surveys Writing and producing reports, research papers or briefs Excellent written English communication skills with documentation abilities Project or program coordination, including client communications and data processes Pulling out data from secondary sources and journals, and working with a team | Competency: High levels of drive and willingness to learn, a strong work ethic, the ability to achieve stretched targets, and high levels of emotional stability. | Preferred: Ph.D. in relevant disciplines. Assessing Social Return on Investment (SROI) would be an added advantage. | Mandatory qualification: Master's degree in management, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Social Sciences, Environmental Studies, or a related field from a recognized university. | Mandatory experience: Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience in CSR, sustainability, ESG, or corporate citizenship roles within corporate, academic, research, or consulting institutions. | Technical knowledge: In-depth understanding of Indian CSR regulations (Companies Act, 2013; Schedule VII; NBFC CSR rules), SDGs, global standards (UNGC, ISO 26000), and impact measurement tools. | Essential skills: | Excellent written and verbal communication for report writing, presentations and stakeholder interactions Proficiency in research methodologies, data analysis (using tools like Excel, SPSS, or NVivo) and content development Strong project management abilities, including budgeting, timelines and multi-stakeholder coordination Strategic thinking with a passion for sustainability and corporate responsibility Proficiency in MS Office Suite Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment and travel as needed | Preferred: A PhD or certifications in CSR/Sustainability will be an advantage. A proven track record in program design/delivery or advisory services is preferred. Familiarity with digital learning platforms (such as LMS) and virtual collaboration tools is desirable. | Mandatory qualification: Articleship of CA/CS/ICWA or related disciplines, with exposure on CSR, sustainability or related fields. | Required skills: | Proficiency with MS Office and Canva, particularly MS Word and MS Excel (Excel is a must) Good communication and writing skills, enough to contribute to research reports and presentations Strong attention to detail, an analytical mindset and the ability to draw insights from data Enthusiasm for CSR and sustainability topics, and the ability to work in a team Travel to field areas across India for data collection, meetings and business development is a must | Preferred: | 1-3 years' experience (internships, research assistantships, articleship or related roles) in conducting research or data analysis is a plus Experience of handling files, the eProcurement system within the govt. system and tenders of the development sector Experience of preparing presentations on infographics software Proficiency in data analysis software such as SPSS, R or similar tools | Successful completion of articleship of CA/CS/ICWA is considered equivalent to one year of experience. | See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Confirm that you meet the age, qualification and experience criteria for the post. Candidature stands cancelled if you do not, or if you furnish false information or suppress a material fact.
Open the application link for your post from the table under Important Links.
Mention all your qualifications and relevant experience above the minimum prescribed, and make sure the details are complete, accurate and correct.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Submit the application so that it reaches IICA on or before the last date. Late applications are summarily rejected.
Matriculation or equivalent certificate in support of age
Degree, Diploma or other certificates, including mark-sheets, in support of educational qualifications
The authority (with number and date) under which a qualification is treated as equivalent, where applicable

Certificates from the Head of the Organisation or Department for all experience claimed, showing the duration of employment (date, month and year), basic pay and consolidated pay, and the nature of duties, on Letter Head and duly stamped by the Competent Authority

Do not send original certificates with the application. Produce them at the presentation and/or interview. Documents must not carry any correction, alteration or tampering, and any inconsistency between documents must be explained.

content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. Its 14-acre campus is at Plot No.6, 7 & 8, Sector-5, IMT Manesar, District-Gurugram, Haryana. It provides knowledge and professional training through five Schools and eleven Centres, and also serves as a Government think tank on corporate laws, policies and governance.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Posts
content_sections.text: Conduct general research connected to CSR and sustainability Organize research on needs and impact assessment, baseline studies and SROI, including proposals, literature reviews, questionnaires, field surveys and data collection Collect, record, analyse and evaluate data and facts Support, facilitate and maintain CSR data Do any other duty entrusted by the Competent Authority Collaborate with the WNS Research team, Finance and Administration stakeholders and experts to ensure smooth project execution Assist in opportunity reviews to identify key tenders and relevant studies in CSR and sustainability Support research administration, including record-keeping and documentation Handle the Centre's office files, coordinate with other units, schools and centres of IICA, and arrange logistics Maintain records, prepare data sheets and update content modules Follow up on invoices and settlement of advances for ongoing and upcoming projects Handle or coordinate the Learning Management System

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications received by the due date are screened against the minimum educational qualifications and experience prescribed. The duly constituted Selection Committee shortlists candidates. The Institute reserves the right to devise its own shortlisting criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference, on a date and time communicated separately. Holding the minimum qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. IICA communicates only with shortlisted candidates and does not entertain interim correspondence or personal enquiries. No TA/DA is permissible for attending the interview. Final results will be published on the IICA website once the process concludes. Selected candidates may have to undergo a medical examination, if required.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for one year at first, and may be extended or curtailed depending on performance and requirement. WNS Project positions can be extended up to the duration of the Project, as they are co-terminus with it. The assignment is full time. The person must attend office on all working days, and on holidays if required. Selected candidates must sign a contract with IICA and join the duties immediately. Either side can end the contract with two months' notice, or two months' consolidated emoluments in lieu. A consultant cannot apply for any position inside or outside IICA while the contract is valid, or before 02 years of joining the position (where the contract provides for extension after one year), whichever is later. To apply internally for another position, the consultant must terminate the present contract. Leave and increments are as per the policy of the Institute.

faq.question: Q1. Does completed articleship count as experience for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Yes. Successful completion of articleship of CA/CS/ICWA is considered equivalent to one year of experience.

faq.question: Q2. Will I get HRA or DA along with the monthly pay?
faq.answer: No. The Rs. 75,000/-, Rs. 1,00,000/- and Rs. 40,000/- amounts are consolidated, and no other allowances or benefits are admissible.

faq.question: Q3. Can a candidate older than 63 apply?
faq.answer: The limit of 63 years may be relaxed, but only in the case of an exceptional candidate.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The presentation and/or interview will be held at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference.

faq.question: Q5. Which document is accepted as proof of date of birth?
faq.answer: Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation, Higher Secondary Examination Certificate or an equivalent certificate is accepted, and no later request to change it will be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Will my application be rejected if I do not attach certificates?
faq.answer: Yes. An application received without copies of the required certificates will be rejected, and no appeal will be entertained. Mark sheets alone in place of a Degree, Diploma or Certificate are also not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. Does the Project Assistant job involve travel?
faq.answer: Yes. Travel to field areas across India for data collection, meetings and business development is a must.

faq.question: Q8. How long can the WNS Project posts continue?
faq.answer: They start with one year and can be extended up to the duration of the Project, based on performance and project requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Can a selected candidate leave before the contract ends?
faq.answer: Yes. The contract can be ended by giving two months' notice or two months' consolidated emoluments in lieu.

faq.question: Q10. Can canvassing affect my application?
faq.answer: Yes. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
